text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, I've been feeling in great shape 
ever since I started doing recovery 
training."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
All I've been doing is standard routines 
like stretching and jogging with care, but 
fatigue doesn't linger like it used to.
choice_data_list:
That's proof your fatigue recovery is 
improving!

text_block_list.text:
Recovery training that enhances healing 
capacity builds a body that is less prone 
to fatigue when practiced consistently.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Still, even if I show you this, it won't 
really make you feel like my recovery 
power went up, will it...?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
How should I present myself so that people 
think, "She can win the Tokyo Yushun 
(Japanese Derby) even starting from the 
Aoba Sho!"?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I've thought up all kinds of 
approaches, but they just lack impact...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
It looks like nothing more than an 
'ordinary countermeasure'... At any rate, 
let's think it over while we eat lunch.
choice_data_list:
Oh, this meal was made with fatigue 
recovery in mind.

Ah, this meal is designed for fatigue 
recovery, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, after all, Trainer went through the 
trouble of coming up with it for me♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text: Um... May I sit next to you...?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Oh, Chitose O-san. Please, go right ahead!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text: If so, pardon the intrusion—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
"...Um... Royce-san, would you care for... 
a drink, if you'd like?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
It's homemade... medicinal herbal soup. 
It's effective... for recovering from 
fatigue, after all.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
My! Did you overhear our conversation 
earlier? Thank you very much, we'll gladly 
take some!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Food and medicine share the same 
origin…… As my body is rather frail…… I 
always incorporate…… medicinal cuisine 
into my diet……

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ...Ah! Is that it? Yes—I see!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Chitose O-san! There's something I'd like 
to consult you about—"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: And Royce and Royce!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chitose O's...—

text_block_list.name: Royce & Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
An athlete's "food is medicine" diet~~! An 
athlete's... "food is medicine" diet...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Chitose O-san, I'm going to run in the 
Aoba Sho and the Nippon Derby coming up."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Still, the interval between the two races 
is quite short, isn't it? I'm worried 
about whether lingering fatigue will 
remain after the race..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, mm... Fatigue... is a state where 
either "qi", "blood", or "fluids" are 
disrupted...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Restore that balance... through food. 
Allow me to teach you the philosophy of 
dietary therapy—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
So, what is best to consume immediately 
after a race?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
A cold roselle tea would be lovely after a 
race.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Luoshen flower, that's hibiscus, right! If 
I recall... it's rich in vitamin C.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Cooling it down moderately should 
serve well…… For it aids in releasing…… 
the heat accumulated within the body.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
To accelerate recovery from muscle 
fatigue... sour foods work best.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Mmm-!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: So sour!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho... Eating an umeboshi in one whole 
bite? My, what a little rascal...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Something sour... paired with meat to 
replenish the "blood." Pork rolled with 
pickled plum might be a good choice...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I-I wish you had told me that first... 
It's so sour...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Ever since I fixed my diet based on 
Chitose O-san's advice, I don't feel as 
worn out after training anymore!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, even the chest expander 
that I used to struggle with—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Look! I beat my personal record!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Food and medicine share the same source; 
if you condition the body... it brings 
about a virtuous cycle... the law of 
nature...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Well then... I look forward to the day we 
meet again... when you've grown even 
stronger from healthy eating...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
If that be the case... Then we shall 
settle this at the Aoba Sho and the Nippon 
Derby.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
—Huh? The Aoba Sho and the Nippon Derby!? 
Aren't our rotations exactly the same!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text: Hohohohoho...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Giving aid to your own rival... Chitose 
O-san, you're way too soft-hearted!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
So, look forward to my showdown with 
Chitose O too, okay!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, herbal cuisine really does sound 
like it works! If this solves my fatigue 
issue, doesn't it feel like I could win 
the Derby?"

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
In addition to adopting recovery methods, 
I should train my recuperative powers, 
huh...? If I go that far, I can definitely 
make it work, right?!

Expectations for Royce and Royce are 
soaring. All that's left now is to win the 
Aoba Sho—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ...*Haah*, *haah*, *haah*...
choice_data_list:
The issue is your form breaking down when 
you lean forward.

The issue is your form breaking down when 
you lean forward.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...I understand it in my head, but... 
whenever I try to accelerate, I just 
can't...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...My legs just couldn't keep up with the 
image in my head...
choice_data_list:
Times like that are exactly when you need 
to maintain proper form.

It's at times like those that you must 
maintain proper form.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: I'm going for one more...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
—No, until my body learns the proper form. 
Please, keep going!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!
choice_data_list:
You're leaning too far! Your legs aren't 
lifting!

text_block_list.text:
A first-rate athlete knows how to run. And 
possesses the skeletal frame and 
musculature to make it happen.

"That is true talent. An innate gift and 
ability born within them."

For the untalented to reach the same 
heights, it takes many times more effort 
and time. And they might even reach their 
limit before arriving there—

Royce and Royce's abilities were 
formidable. However, they weren't quite 
enough to be called truly top-tier.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Trainer, what was my time...?
choice_data_list:
...Your form was looking better than 
before.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"...Compared to the final training times 
Taishin-san and the others set for the 
Satsuki Sho, we still have a long way to 
go..."

The time was faster than the run before. 
Yet, what would be the point in telling 
her that?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Let's do one more rep after a short break. 
Once we get your condition sorted out, 
your time should improve too.
choice_data_list:
You're right. Shall we relax with some 
herbal tea?

Yeah. Shall we relax with some herbal 
medicinal tea?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Yes.

The more training piled up, the more 
tangible the clear difference in raw 
strength became—

Royce and Royce had surely been confronted 
with that cold, hard truth again and again 
and again.

As long as she remains an athlete, that is 
something unavoidable.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: She's fast!! No way, it can't be—!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"She's on a whole... different level... To 
think she was... this incredible...!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Haa, hah.... Kh... Why...

"Yet, no matter how many times one 
experiences it... there is no getting used 
to that pain."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Please tell me... what did I do 
wrong just now?!
choice_data_list: Yeah! That run just now was—

text_block_list.text: The day of the Aoba Sho—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...I can't believe Chitose O is scratching 
from the race...
choice_data_list:
They said it's nothing serious, but I'm 
still worried.

They said it's nothing serious, but I'm 
still worried.

text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chitose O has a rather delicate 
constitution, so she seems to have avoided 
overexerting herself.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to her philosophy that food and 
medicine share the same source, my 
recovery from fatigue went so much 
smoother.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
To show my gratitude to her, I'll run a 
great race!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
To make this produce a success, taking 1st 
place in the Aoba Sho is a must.
choice_data_list:
As you are now, you can win! Have 
confidence!

As you are now, you can win! Have 
confidence!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'll secure victory and fuel the 
anticipation for a historic, unprecedented 
feat!
